description: Fires when the opponent has an immediate win in column 6 (the rightmost column) that I must block, above the bottom row; strongest (20-40) when their last move just made it, typically a vertical three in column 6 or a horizontal three ending at column 6. Weak firing (1-4) for freshly made vertical threes in other columns (0,1,4,5). Bottom-row threats at (0,6) and stale threats barely fire.
effect: Pushes the move to column 6: forced to max on neutral positions it moves about 95% of probability onto column 6. Zeroing it changes nothing measurable (the block is already chosen with near-certainty).
notes: p1 any col6 must-block F1 0.51; p3 fresh col6 must-block row>=1 P 0.89 R 0.32; best p5 (col6 must-block row>=1 or fresh edge-column vertical three) F1 0.528, AUROC 0.82. Strong core is clean and confirmed by minimal pairs (col6 vertical 39.5 vs col0 2.7; same threat 2 plies stale 3.5; unplayable threat 2.0). Weak tail near threshold is diffuse and not captured. Simulation share undefined (nan; ceiling negative). No synthesis beat the dev max (best 39.5 vs 44.4).
